payload.evidence_against: T036 path-conditioned evidence is weak, repeated GR motifs and missingness can create ambiguous local emissions, and prior HMM/DTW, raw-state, residual-profile, and analog-identity routes failed legal transfer.
payload.evidence_for: The admissible complete-path set contains every exact T036 nonzero action and the zero fallback, so its hidden-label oracle is no worse than the verified 4.6284573670 RMSE. T036 compressed each candidate into 39 summaries before ranking and had only 2.9495% top-16 oracle recall, leaving full row/node emission structure untested.
payload.next_test: Implement only the frozen T037 node/state emission and hard Viterbi gate with exact path deduplication, full outer isolation, and transition-only, reversed, shifted, permuted, shuffled, graph-randomized, and sign-flipped controls.
payload.statement: A split-local structured decoder over the exact deduplicated union graph of the T036 action bank can use row-level candidate-conditioned GR emissions and continuity to recover sub-5-capacity paths that candidate-level summary ranking cannot identify.
payload.title: Full-emission structured decoding identifies a high-capacity path
